claim: In critically ill adults, oxygen consumption rises with oxygen delivery: across 40 patients, the Pearson correlation between oxygen consumption and oxygen delivery is at least 0.5.

data_keys.meaning: cardiac output, L/min, from thermodilution
blood hemoglobin concentration, g/dL
arterial oxygen saturation, fraction 0-1
mixed venous oxygen saturation, fraction 0-1
oxygen consumption, mL/min, measured by expired-gas analysis at the same time as the haemodynamic measurements

claim: In critically ill adults, systemic vascular resistance falls as cardiac output rises: across 100 patients, the Spearman rank correlation between systemic vascular resistance and cardiac output is at most -0.4.

data_keys.meaning: mean arterial pressure, mmHg
central venous pressure, mmHg
cardiac output, L/min, by pulmonary-artery thermodilution
cardiac output, L/min, by echocardiographic Doppler, measured at the same time by a separate operator

claim: In patients with heart failure, a larger right ventricular end-diastolic volume goes with a lower right ventricular ejection fraction: across 30 patients, the standardised slope (both variables z-scored) of end-diastolic volume index on ejection fraction is at most -0.4.

data_keys.meaning: stroke volume index, mL/m2, from thermodilution
right ventricular ejection fraction, fraction 0-1, from a fast-response thermistor catheter
right ventricular end-diastolic volume index, mL/m2, from gated radionuclide ventriculography done in the same session

claim: A dobutamine infusion in critically ill adults raises oxygen consumption in proportion to the rise in oxygen delivery: across 24 patients, the proportion of variance in the change in oxygen consumption explained by the change in oxygen delivery (R squared of a simple linear regression) is at least 0.25.

data_keys.meaning: cardiac output, L/min, by thermodilution; axis 1 = [before infusion, during infusion]
blood hemoglobin concentration, g/dL; axis 1 = [before, during]
arterial oxygen saturation, fraction 0-1; axis 1 = [before, during]
mixed venous oxygen saturation, fraction 0-1; axis 1 = [before, during]
oxygen consumption, mL/min, from expired-gas analysis; axis 1 = [before, during]

claim: Across 120 adult human skeletons, femur length relative to vertebral column length and tibia length relative to vertebral column length are positively related: the Pearson correlation between the two relative lengths is at least 0.4.

data_keys.meaning: maximum femur length, mm
maximum tibia length, mm
length of the articulated vertebral column, mm

claim: Wealthier countries emit more carbon dioxide per person: across 150 countries, the Spearman rank correlation between per-capita carbon dioxide emissions and per-capita gross domestic product is at least 0.5.

data_keys.meaning: annual national carbon dioxide emissions, megatonnes
national gross domestic product, billions of US dollars (purchasing-power adjusted)
national population, millions

claim: Across 90 farms, a farm that applies more fertilizer per hectare obtains a higher crop yield per hectare: the standardised regression slope (both variables z-scored) of yield per hectare on fertilizer per hectare is at least 0.3.

data_keys.meaning: total annual crop harvest of the farm, tonnes
total annual fertilizer applied on the farm, kg of nitrogen
cropped area of the farm, hectares

claim: In trained athletes, aerobic capacity per kilogram of body mass goes with sprint power per kilogram of body mass: across 30 athletes, the proportion of variance in peak power per kilogram explained by maximal oxygen uptake per kilogram (R squared of a simple linear regression) is at least 0.25.

data_keys.meaning: maximal oxygen uptake, L/min, from an incremental treadmill test
peak power output in a 10-second cycle sprint, W
body mass, kg

claim: Larger hospitals have lower hospital-acquired infection rates per admission: across 100 hospitals, the standardised regression slope (variables z-scored) of infections per admission on the number of beds is at most -0.3.

data_keys.meaning: number of hospital-acquired infections recorded in one year
number of patient admissions in the same year
number of staffed beds

claim: In adult rats, a heavier heart relative to body weight goes with higher systolic blood pressure: across 60 rats, the standardised regression slope (variables z-scored) of systolic pressure on heart weight per body weight is at least 0.3.

data_keys.meaning: systolic blood pressure, mmHg, by tail-cuff
wet heart weight at necropsy, g
body weight at necropsy, g

claim: Buildings with more occupants use less energy per square metre of floor area: across 150 office buildings, the Spearman rank correlation between the number of occupants and annual energy use per square metre is at most -0.3.

data_keys.meaning: annual metered energy use, MWh
gross floor area, square metres
typical number of occupants (headcount)

claim: Firms with a larger payroll have lower staff turnover rates: across 250 firms, the proportion of variance in the annual turnover rate (leavers per employee) explained by the payroll (R squared of a simple linear regression) is at least 0.1.

data_keys.meaning: number of employees who left the firm during the year
average number of employees during the year
total annual payroll, millions of currency units
